service.description:
Every tenant's scheduled automations on one instance-wide timeline, ordered by the moment the scheduler will actually submit them, for deployment and load management.
Only the first fire per automation is authoritative — it is the stored nextScheduledFireTime the scanner owns. Later entries are projected from scheduleExpr and assume the automation is not paused, edited, or deferred by the concurrency cap before it gets there.
Fire times are absolute instants; submitsAt snaps each one up to the next scan_ReconciliationAutomations_5m tick ("0 0/5 * * * ?"), because nothing is submitted between ticks. concurrentAtTick counts the fires sharing a tick, to be read against inFlightCap (darpan.reconciliation.automation.maxConcurrentExecutions).

parameter.name: horizonHours
parameter.description: How far forward to project. Defaults to 24 hours.

parameter.name: inFlightCap
parameter.description: Global cap on executions in flight at once, not a per-tenant cap.

parameter.name: inFlight
parameter.description: Executions started but not finished, oldest first.

parameter.name: fires
parameter.description: Projected submissions across the horizon, earliest first.

parameter.name: paused
parameter.description: Inactive automations — listed for inventory, never projected.
